title: Reduce recovery packets to current work and relevant context
outcome: A resumed agent receives compact current-work context with exact locators for historical details instead of repeated conversation history.
acceptance: Document the baseline recovery packet and identify duplicated historical notifications, completed exchanges and unrelated work.
Deliver a bounded packet containing current objective, next action, applicable constraints, unresolved dependencies and exact evidence locators, with explicit indication of omitted detail.

Compare representative source-backed before/after recovery payloads demonstrating less redundant context while the agent correctly recovers scope, STOP conditions and the next authorized action; optional byte counts may support the comparison.

completion.summary: Compact recovery shows current objective, duties, next actions, constraints and dependencies with exact detail routes and explicit omissions; pending handoffs remain visible. Full gate and required Codex/Kimi reviews passed; independent evaluation 3/3, acceptance unchanged.
